items.title: University of Nottingham Confirms Breach After Hackers Leak Data

items.title: Microsoft Exchange Server 0-Day Vulnerability Exploited in Attacks Using Weaponized Email
items.description: Microsoft has confirmed active exploitation of a new zero‑day spoofing flaw in on‑premises Exchange Server, tracked as CVE‑2026‑42897. The flaw allows attackers to execute arbitrary JavaScript in Outlook Web Access (OWA) simply by sending a weaponized email that a victim opens in a browser. items.title: Microsoft Patches Exploited Exchange Server Vulnerability
items.description: The company warned about zero-day attacks exploiting the Exchange Server vulnerability CVE-2026-42897 on May 14. The post Microsoft Patches Exploited Exchange Server Vulnerability appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: GitHub to Disable npm Install Scripts by Default to Stop Supply Chain Attacks
items.description: GitHub has announced what it said are "breaking changes" coming to npm version 12, one of which turns off install scripts by default to combat software supply chain threats. items.title: ZDI-CAN-31586: Linux
items.description: A CVSS score 7.8 AV:L/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Lucas Leong (@_wmliang_) of TrendAI Zero Day Initiative' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2026-06-10, 1 days ago. The vendor is given until 2026-10-08 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
